stories.title: Ranking the 0-2 NFL teams: Which still have playoff hope, and which could be in for long seasons?
stories.summary: Can the Texans turn it around (again)? Do the Buccaneers, Colts or Chargers have a chance to get right? Is the season already over for the Falcons and Dolphins?

stories.title: White Sox clinch AL playoff berth after 324 losses over past 3 seasons
stories.summary: The White Sox became the first team to follow consecutive 100-loss seasons by reaching the playoffs, clinching at least an AL Wild Card berth with win No. 82 this year.

stories.title: 49ers' Juszczyk fined for 'offensive' act of pretending to chug beer
stories.summary: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 on Thursday for "engaging in offensive demonstrations."

stories.title: Cubs clinch second straight playoff berth with win over Marlins
stories.summary: The Chicago Cubs clinched their second straight postseason berth a 2-1 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday.

stories.title: Bob Pettit, NBA's first MVP and a 'true giant of the game,' dies at 93
stories.summary: Bob Pettit, who was named an All-Star in each of his 11 NBA seasons and was one of the greatest scorers and rebounders in league history, died, the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame said Thursday.
